name: B10-0424/2026 – § 9 – Am 112
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 9. Deplores the fact that, despite warnings by several parliamentary groups and intellectuals, FEMYSO was once again able to be invited to the European Parliament by Members from The Left and the Greens on 21 September 2026; calls for all organisations linked to the Council of European Muslims, such as FEMYSO, to be denied access to theEuropean institutions and for the institutions to ensure that the events and meetings they organise, host or participate in do not contribute to legitimising the entryism strategies of FEMYSO or other structures linked to the Muslim Brotherhood, and to end the participation of such organisations in those events and meetings; calls for organisations linked to the Council of European Muslims to be removed from the EU Transparency Register;
